usedFor: Contacts+ holds scanned and saved contacts, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a business card is transcribed” in Contacts+, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A transcribed card is a clean cue to start a script on one of your computers.

watchOut: “Trigger Command” acts on your computers, so confirm which machine and command each run will start.
